summary: Cellyan Biotechnology filed a Form 6-K disclosing that independent director Mike Yao Zhou resigned effective September 18, 2026 from the board and all three committees, including as Compensation Committee chair. The same day the board ratified Letao Zhao as independent director, committee member and Compensation Committee chair, and he accepted an offer letter and consent to act. No price, stake or premium terms apply. Zhao brings retail and restaurant operations experience; no related-party transactions were disclosed. The change appears orderly rather than forced, so watch for further board or governance turnover.
